description:
File a report in the support team's queue under your account, with your name and email attached for the team. No email is sent to you.
Use for: a platform failure, an unexpected reply, a billing question, or anything you cannot solve yourself. Each call files a new report, so send one once.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: report_support_issue({"summary":"pay_hire answered internal_error twice","description":"I called pay_hire for hire h4Tq9 at 14:02 and 14:05 UTC. Both answered internal_error and get_hire still shows the hire as submitted.","category":"billing","priority":"high","errorCode":"internal_error","sourceTool":"pay_hire"})
Repeat: A repeat may act again on the thing as it stands then. Read it first.
Errors: report_refused; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

description.description: What you did, what you expected, what happened instead. At most 5,000.

errorCode.description: The error code or exception name you got. At most 200.

priority.description: How urgent it is for you. Left out: none.

sourceTool.description: The tool or workflow where it happened. At most 100.

summary.description: One line on what went wrong. At most 160.

name: report_support_issue

reportId.description: The id of the report in the support queue.

title: Report a problem to support
